ValidationRule.description: Require a CSM User and reject missing, non-18-character or case-mismatched relationship keys using case-sensitive CONTAINS and explicit length.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(CSM_User__c), ISBLANK(CSM_User_Key__c), LEN(CSM_User_Key__c) <> 18, NOT(CONTAINS(CSM_User_Key__c, CASESAFEID(CSM_User__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a CSM User and supply the matching 18-character User Key.
